subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Retain the predecessor's measured ProcessCritter sibling-loop differences, but retract its inference that these PROVE source impossibility. Identical loop text does not imply identical surrounding liveness, inline context or compiler IR identity; source reconstruction need not edit both loops identically. Constructive counterexample in the previously denied family: InitControls, stock GC/1.2.5 with unchanged actual Ninja flags, becomes raw exact27/27 by calling the EXISTING clear_pad_levels helper instead of duplicating its same five-array loop. Baseline +0x20 li r3,0 and +0x28 addi r0,r3,0 become target li r5,0 and addi r3,r5,0, with the five target zero stores, resolving all7 raw words and retiring its value-equality WebFrank rule. All43 raw siblings, data/BSS, EH and resolved relocation bindings are preserved. The helper was already used by ClearAllPlayerControls and its definition is unchanged. This proves a natural source-level path exists for this instance, not that every residual is solvable through helpers. Compiler-internal inliner/IR identity is the inferred explanation, not a disassembled algorithm. Type-only source controls were neutral here; finite local negative matrices still constrain their measured axes but are not global unreachability proofs.
